import java.io.*;
import java.math.*;

	static void err() {
		System.out.println(-1);
	}
	public static void main (String args[])throws IOException{
		Scanner sc = new Scanner();
		PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);
		int t = 1;
		//t = sc.nextInt();
		while(t-->0) {
			long n=sc.nextInt(), m=sc.nextInt(), l=sc.nextInt(), r=sc.nextInt(), k=r-l, even=k/2+1, odd=(k+1)/2;
			if((n*m)%2==1) {
				out.print(new BigInteger(k+1+"").modPow(new BigInteger(n*m+""), p));
			}else {
				BigInteger temp1 = new BigInteger(even+odd+"").modPow(new BigInteger(n*m+""), p);
				BigInteger temp2 = new BigInteger(even-odd+"").modPow(new BigInteger(n*m+""), p);
				out.println(((Long.parseLong(temp1.toString())+Long.parseLong(temp2.toString()))*(pr+1)/2)%pr);
			}
		}
		out.flush();
	}

	    StringBuilder sb=new StringBuilder(str);  
	    sb.reverse();  
	    return sb.toString();  
	}

    { 
        int i = 0, j = str.length() - 1; 
  
        while (i < j) { 
  
            if (str.charAt(i) != str.charAt(j)) 
                return false; 
  
            
            i++; 
            j--; 
        } 
        return true;
    }

		for(int i=0; i<arr.length; i++)
			System.out.print(arr[i]+" ");
		System.out.println();
	}

	public static long abs(long x) {return ((x > 0) ? x : -x);}
	public static int max(int a, int b) {return Math.max(a, b);}
	public static long max(long a, long b) {return Math.max(a, b);}
	public static int min(int a, int b) {return Math.min(a, b);}
	public static long min(long a, long b) {return Math.min(a, b);}

    { 
        if (a == 0) 
            return b; 
        return gcd(b % a, a); 
    }

    { 
        int g = gcd(a, m); 
        if (g != 1) 
            return -1;
        else 
        	return power(a, m - 2, m); 
        
    }

    { 
        if (y == 0) 
            return 1; 
          
        int p = power(x, y / 2, m) % m; 
        p = (p * p) % m; 
      
        if (y % 2 == 0) 
            return p; 
        else
            return (x * p) % m; 
    }

    		while(num%2==0) {
    			num/=2;
    			factor*=2;
    		}

    	}

    		}
    	}

	static boolean isPrime(int n) 
    { 
        // Corner cases 
        if (n <= 1) 
            return false; 
        if (n <= 3) 
            return true; 
  
        // This is checked so that we can skip 
        // middle five numbers in below loop 
        if (n % 2 == 0 || n % 3 == 0) 
            return false; 
  
        for (int i = 5; i * i <= n; i = i + 6) 
            if (n % i == 0 || n % (i + 2) == 0) 
                return false; 
  
        return true;
    }

	static void shuffle(int[] a) {
		int n = a.length;
		Random rand = new Random();
		for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
			int tmpIdx = rand.nextInt(n);
			int tmp = a[i];
			a[i] = a[tmpIdx];
